view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Dominating the background are tall red metal shelving units packed with boxes and pallets. In the foreground, an orange forklift is partially visible on the right. A person walks in the distance near blue racks on the left. The space is brightly lit by overhead lights.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered shelves filled with cardboard boxes and white labels. Located centrally in the background, spanning much of the frame width. Appears stationary and supported by vertical metal posts. Partially obscured by other objects in the foreground.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Partially visible on the right edge, showing its cab and front section. The vehicle is positioned near the shelving. Its controls and green indicator light are visible. It appears to be parked or moving slowly, with no clear contact points visible.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A figure in dark clothing walking toward the left side of the frame, near blue racks. Their motion causes slight blur. They appear to be carrying something or pushing equipment. Unclear if they are interacting with any specific object.

objects.label: blue metal racks
objects.observation: Tall, blue industrial racks located on the far left. They hold stacked items, possibly containers or boxes. Positioned against the wall. The racks appear freestanding but likely anchored to the floor.

objects.label: stacked red plastic crates
objects.observation: Several red plastic crates stacked neatly on wooden pallets in the center-right area. They are arranged in two columns. The crates are empty and appear unused. No visible supports or attachments beyond the pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Multiple wooden pallets scattered throughout the scene. Some hold crates, others have cardboard boxes or barrels. One pallet is directly under the red crates. Another holds a blue barrel. All appear to rest on the concrete floor.

objects.label: blue barrel
objects.observation: A single blue plastic barrel standing upright on a wooden pallet near the center-right. It is cylindrical and has a lid. It appears to be full or partially filled. No visible supports or attachments beyond the pallet.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36540", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
